electric-violet.$description: Electric Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Saturated brand depth — testimonial card backgrounds, gradient mid-stops, and decorative fills that reinforce violet identity without competing with Electric Violet for attention

periwinkle-glow.$description: Periwinkle Glow — Soft brand highlight — icon tints, secondary accents, and gradient highlights that lighten the violet palette for hover states and decorative ornament

halo-violet.$description: Halo Violet — Radial gradient seed — the orb color that radiates from the hero top-left corner and bleeds into card backgrounds, creating atmosphere without flat fill

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas — the deep near-black backdrop for the entire site. Carries a subtle violet undertone that keeps the darkness warm and on-brand rather than cold

onyx.$description: Onyx — Card surfaces and hairline borders — one step lighter than the canvas, creates soft layering without shadows. Used for widget tree panels, input fields, and elevated containers

slate-mist.$description: Slate Mist — Muted body and helper text — descriptions, metadata, secondary nav items. Sits clearly below white in hierarchy while maintaining AAA contrast on the dark canvas

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

true-black.$description: True Black — Icon detail in light/banner contexts and SVG illustration fills where maximum contrast is required against white backgrounds

urbanist.$description: Primary brand typeface — headlines at 72–120px with wide tracking (0.038em–0.045em) create an architectural, restrained authority. Body and UI at 14–24px in weight 400. The geometric humanist forms are distinctive against the typical Inter/sans default of devtools.

inter.$description: Secondary UI typeface — eyebrows, labels, nav items, and micro-copy where Inter's tighter rhythm supports dense interface text. Weight 300 brings an anti-convention lightness to small caps tracking.
